notes:
Account background:
- Mid-market SaaS provider (B2B customer support platform). Fast-growing; primary product is in-app support chat + automation.
- Evaluating Redwood Hosted API for MLP chat agents; long-term interest in Dedicated for predictable throughput.

Decision drivers / requirements:
- Workload: interactive support agents + orchestration (tool calling to CRM, KB lookup). Streaming required for agent UI.
- Latency: First-token SLO < 1.5s for typical US requests; ideal 0.7-1.0s. 95th percentile target for streaming start ~<1.2s.
- Throughput: baseline 60 concurrent agent sessions, spike to ~150 concurrent during peak; want predictable p99 latency.
- Cost sensitivity: want guidance on batching/quant profiles to keep monthly inference spend ~<$15k while maintaining quality.
- Model preference: open model preferred for cost transparency; will consider small Llama-family variants and Redwood-verified quantized builds.
- Routing/fallback: must support fallback to cheaper model variant during capacity/price pressure; tool calling reliability required.

Recent activity / timeline:
- 2026-01-20: Intro call (Ariella) — product overview, high-level requirements. Fireflies ff_20260214_0123 attached.
- 2026-02-02: Technical walkthrough with SE (Devon) — covered streaming API, function calling semantics, sample prompt templates.
- 2026-02-14: Demo session (streaming test) — initial streaming latency ok in region but p95 spikes on longer contexts. Action: run instrumented POC.
- 2026-02-18: Security questionnaire sent; they requested SOC2 evidence and KMS integration details. Drive doc updated.
- 2026-02-22: Pricing touchpoint — interested in 12-month reserved capacity if POC meets latency and cost targets.

POC scope (requested):
- 2-week streaming POC using Hosted API (EU + US regions).
- Test cases: new chat session cold-start first-token time, tool-call roundtrip (CRM lookup -> response), long conversation (>2k tokens) continuation latency.
- Metrics to prove: first-token <1.5s median, stability under 150 concurrent users, function-calling success rate >99%.
- Deliverables: instrumentation dashboard (per-route latency/token breakdown), suggested batching/quant settings, fallback policy for cost surge.

Quotes / notes from champions:
- "If we can't show sub-1.5s first-token on hosted during demo, execs will ask for Dedicated timing numbers before committing." — Head of Product (call 2026-02-14).
- "We like Redwood's routing/fallback story; need clear cost model for moving to Dedicated." — CTO.

Open questions / blockers:
- SOC2: they asked for timeline for SOC2 artifacts and whether Redwood can provide a recent security audit. (security deck linked)
- EU data residency: need clarification on where short-term KV caching is stored for EU customers.
- Pricing: need example ARR-based committed reserved pricing tiers for expected throughput.

Next steps (short):
- Kick off 2-week POC w/ test harness and synthetic concurrency (target start 2026-03-02).
- Provide Dedicated 12-month pricing scenario if POC meets SLOs.
- SE to validate tool-calling reliability with their CRM sandbox (Jira INF-1974).

Internal deal notes (AE/SE):
- High upsell potential to Dedicated if POC demonstrates <1.2s median first-token and <1.5s 95th.
- Recommend enabling prefix caching and conservative batching; propose trial quantized model variant to hit cost target.
- Keep security team looped — key blocker for closing is SOC2 evidence and KMS integration details.
